summary: Backend-only test of the clone-install fix for the 'Terjadi kesalahan database after forced password change' report. I built fresh clone packages from the source site (http://localhost:8080) via cloning start/step/download, 2 builds: without sample data and with include_sample=1, both valid zips. I installed each on MariaDB 10.11.19 (localhost socket) and on MySQL 8.0.40 (127.0.0.1;port=3307, global sql_mode ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY+STRICT+NO_ZERO_DATE), with debug=false and a DB user that only has privileges on its own database. Full flow on all 4 installs: real captcha login, forced redirect to /admin/akun, POST /admin/akun/simpan, redirect to /admin/dashboard with 200 and no DB error, logout, login with the new password, 28 admin menus and public pages all 200 with no 'kesalahan database'. ALL PASS. Error page: with the complaints table renamed, a logged-in admin gets a 500 page with 'Detail teknis (hanya terlihat oleh admin)', the SQLSTATE 42S02 message, the location and 'Kode: XXXXXXXX'. An anonymous visitor on /pengaduan gets only the generic message and the Kode, with no SQL detail. error_log records '[DB error [CODE] uri | msg @ file:line]' and the codes match. Passed on both MySQL 8 and MariaDB, and the table was restored. Regression on the source site: 12 public pages and 29 admin pages (including cloning) are 200 with no DB error. The customer's own hosting could not be reached, so its actual failing query is still unconfirmed.

minor.issue: Unlike db_row/db_val/db_exec/db_insert, it does not call $st->closeCursor(). AkunController::simpan uses db_update and then log_activity (db_insert). On drivers that are sensitive to statement state this is the remaining gap in the fix. Add closeCursor for consistency.
Cosmetic: the trace repeats the first location (e.g. 'Lokasi: core/Helpers.php:156 ← core/Helpers.php:156 ← DashboardController.php:35'). Skip trace frames whose file:line equals $where.

action_items: Optional: add closeCursor() to db_update() for consistency with the other helpers.
Optional: remove the duplicate first trace frame in the renderDbError detail.

Ask the customer to reproduce once on the new build. The page now shows the SQLSTATE detail and Kode to the logged-in admin, and the hosting error_log has the matching '[DB error [CODE] ...]' line, which will confirm the real cause.
critical_code_review_comments: Evidence: /app/error_log, committed from the source cPanel host, shows repeated driver-level errors in 'Visitor track': 2014 'pending result sets' / 'other unbuffered queries are active', 2027 'Received malformed packet', 2000 'Unknown error', and HY093 'Invalid parameter number' on a correct 13-placeholder INSERT. This points to a pdo_mysql build on that hosting (likely libmysqlclient, not mysqlnd, as on CloudLinux/LiteSpeed) that is fragile with native prepares (ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES=false). The buffered-query and closeCursor changes target this. If the customer still fails, the next step is to set PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => true, as a fallback or config option. This is not reproducible locally because local PHP uses mysqlnd.

No MySQL-8-only or MariaDB-only SQL found: no CTE, window or JSON functions. The dump uses utf8mb4_unicode_ci and InnoDB and is portable. The GENERATED VIRTUAL column in idm_data needs MySQL >=5.7 or MariaDB >=10.2.
SistemController backup calls $pdo->query('SHOW CREATE TABLE')->fetch() without closeCursor. It is a single row so harmless when buffered, but on an unbuffered driver it would desync the same way.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 install flows, 4/4 error-page tests, source regression all 200)

seed_data_creation: Test DBs t1_maria (MariaDB) and t1_m8 (MySQL 8) with users t1u_*: created and dropped. Clone jobs removed, storage/cache restored with git checkout, uploads clean. All activity_logs rows with action='clone' deleted from dawungsr_dbdesa (6 rows; some may have been from the main agent's runs, as instructed). No app code modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Helper scripts: /root/t1_build.sh <zip> <sample0|1> builds a clone package from :8080. /root/t1_install.sh <db> <port> <maria|m8> <zip> installs it with debug=false and a DB user limited to its own database, and starts php -S logging to /root/php<port>.err. Run CLONE_PORTS=8201,8202 pytest backend/tests/test_clone_install_flow.py (installs must be fresh: password rahasia123). The error-page test needs CLONE_PORT/CLONE_PASS=TEST_Baru12345/CLONE_ENGINE/CLONE_DB. Note: public /faq is not a route (404 is expected).
rca of the issue: Could not reproduce on MariaDB 10.11 or MySQL 8.0.40 (strict + ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY, limited user, with and without sample data). The most likely cause, from the source host's error_log, is the hosting's pdo_mysql driver desyncing with native prepared statements (errors 2014/2027/2000/HY093). The applied fix (buffered queries + closeCursor + relaxed sql_mode) addresses this. The new admin-only error detail will confirm or refute it on the customer's hosting. Fallback mitigation: ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES=true.
